statement: An architecture element depends only on its own layer or a lower one (config and events, then planning, knowledge and environment, then the gate, delivery, deploy and the site, then measurement and the model); a dependency that goes up is a defect to break, never accepted by declaring it.
note: PADRAO-DEV F8c: the rule that decided the 29 reflexion divergences of 17/11 (12 accepted, 17 to break).
